label: Regardie — The Published Standard
description: Regardie's publication of the Golden Dawn papers made the reorganized Great Table widely available. His version follows the Golden Dawn arrangement with some editorial standardizations. For most modern practitioners, this is the only Great Table they have seen.
provenance: Regardie was a member of Stella Matutina (a Golden Dawn successor order) and obtained the Order's ritual papers. He published them — against the wishes of remaining Order members — in The Golden Dawn (1937–40). Later editions (1971, 1984) included corrections and additional material.

modifications.description: Regardie made minor editorial standardizations compared to the Golden Dawn's internal documents. These are primarily formatting and capitalization choices, with a small number of actual letter differences between editions.

_note: States 3 (Golden Dawn) and 4 (Regardie) share approximately 99% of cell data. The diff between them is small — estimated ~20 cells. For the initial build, this state can reference the Golden Dawn state data with an overlay of Regardie-specific differences.

stateData._dataStatus: TRANSCRIBED — Uses Golden Dawn cell data as base. Regardie's published version (1984 Llewellyn ed.) is virtually identical; ~20 editorial differences await identification through physical source comparison. See GREAT_TABLE_DATA_GUIDE.md.
